acceptance: MFA/passkeys/reauth cannot be bypassed by VSF; cancellation and sign-out invalidate dependent operations.

positive.fixture: a challenge at the source pauses the grant and a fresh clean observation resumes it; sign-out, revoke and sweep cancel dependent work; the runtime refuses work for a paused, ended or other person

negative.fixture: a different person completing the challenge ends the grant; an unanswered pause expires; reflection check that no method answers a challenge

security_and_source_permissions: VSF waits for MFA, passkeys and reauthentication and never answers them.
performance_memory_storage: Constant-time principal comparison; sweeps are linear in grants.
known_limitations: Pause state, atomicity and epoch semantics were reworked in VSF-B14-T08
